title: RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links” correctly?
options: UART is asynchronous point-to-point serial using TX/RX and common ground
CAN is a noise-tolerant differential, message-based bus used in vehicle ECUs, industrial control, and robotics.
RS-485 is a differential physical signaling layer for long, electrically noisy links.
I2S carries digital audio using bit clock (BCLK), word select (WS/LRCLK), and data lines.
questions.answer: RS-485 is a differential physical signaling layer for long, electrically noisy links.
questions.explanation: RS-485 is a differential physical signaling layer for long, electrically noisy links.

questions.prompt: Which additional fact about “RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links” is accurate?
options: It connects digital microphones, DACs, and audio codecs
Modbus RTU is a message protocol over that link, with device address, function code, data, and CRC check.
ESP32 calls its CAN 2.0 controller peripheral TWAI
questions.answer: Modbus RTU is a message protocol over that link, with device address, function code, data, and CRC check.
questions.explanation: Modbus RTU is a message protocol over that link, with device address, function code, data, and CRC check.

questions.prompt: Which practical detail should be considered when using “RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links”?
options: It is common in meters, building automation, and industrial sensors.
I2C shares SDA/SCL and addresses among devices and needs pull-ups.
it is not UART or I2C.
controller pins cannot connect directly to CAN wiring.
questions.answer: It is common in meters, building automation, and industrial sensors.
questions.explanation: It is common in meters, building automation, and industrial sensors.

questions.prompt: Which statement from the “RS-485 and Modbus RTU: long-distance industrial links” lesson is correct?
options: Important note A separate CAN transceiver is required.
SPI uses SCK/MOSI/MISO plus a CS line per device for fast full-duplex transfer.
Sample rate, slot width, and mono/stereo format must match.

questions.answer: Important note Connect the MCU UART to an RS-485 transceiver, never directly to A/B.
questions.explanation: Important note Connect the MCU UART to an RS-485 transceiver, never directly to A/B.
